subject: Certification staging: evidence gating and timeline request
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@oakridgehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Certification gating and evidence timeline for Oakridge contract

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. Procurement asked me to get a concise milestones table from Redwood so we can align audit windows and evidence deliverables. High-level asks: ISO 27001 scope confirmation, FedRAMP readiness assumptions (if any), and an inventory of what evidence you will need from us vs. what Redwood will produce (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ mappings, KMS attestations, pen test reports, etc.).

Two specific questions we need answered by 11/30 so our procurement team can lock the audit window:
- Can Redwood commit to Q1 2027 audit window (Feb–Mar) assuming the attestation/doc deliverables below are met?
- What exact artifacts will you need from Oakridge (network diagrams, Data Processing Addendum, control owner attestation templates)?

I've attached the RFP excerpt with our proposed audit gating conditions (oakridge-rfp.pdf). Happy to hop on a short call this week — we prefer Wed afternoon.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Oakridge Health

Attachment: oakridge-rfp.pdf (RFP excerpt)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Certification gating and evidence timeline for Oakridge contract

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask and the RFP excerpt. Short answer: we can target a Q1 2027 audit window, but there are a few gating deliverables we need to agree on and dates we need to lock. I've attached a one-page staging roadmap that shows proposed milestones and handoff owners (initial-cert-roadmap.pdf).

High-level commitments from Redwood:
- We will provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2-report-2025.pdf) and an accompanying control mapping to SIG/CAIQ.
- Security will produce KMS integration documentation and a KMS attestation stub confirming key management patterns and rotation cadence.
- We can share pen test summaries; full reports may require a separate NDA in some cases.

What we need from Oakridge:
- Confirmation of ISO scope (systems and regions included).
- Any specific enrollment in FedRAMP (if you require FedRAMP Moderate/High we need to treat this as a custom engagement).
- Network/dataflow diagrams and a named control owner for each critical control (even a one-line contact).

Proposed next steps (fast path):
1) Agree gating list by 11/30 (attachments listed above).
2) Redwood provides KMS attestation + SOC2 + control mapping by 12/15.
3) Oakridge completes control-owner attestations and dataflow diagrams by 1/15.
4) Pen test scheduling and final evidence packet by 1/31.

Can Marissa and Mina jump in with specifics on sample evidence and any internal constraints? If Wed afternoon works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial-cert-roadmap.pdf (one-page staging roadmap)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@oakridgehealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Certification gating and evidence timeline for Oakridge contract

Hi Sarah / team —

Adding detail from the compliance side on what we usually provide vs. what we expect from customers for ISO/FedRAMP-style gating. I attached a control-evidence checklist that maps common asks to owner and typical sample file names.

What Redwood provides (examples):
- SOC 2 Type II report and SOC control mapping to our product surface (we will provide a spreadsheet mapping SOC controls to SIG/CAIQ rows).
- System-level artifacts: encryption-at-rest configuration snapshots, KMS key rotation logs (redacted), and retention policies.
- A readout packet with architecture diagrams for the hosted environment.

What we ask from Oakridge:
- Data flow diagrams that call out PHI/PII boundaries if those are in scope for ISO.
- Attested control owner confirmations for any customer-specific controls (we provide templates — see control-evidence-checklist.xlsx).
- If FedRAMP is required: specifics about impacted FedRAMP controls and whether Oakridge will require us to operate in a FedRAMP-authorized environment (that changes timelines and cost).

Sampling and timelines: for ISO 27001 and a SOC-driven audit cadence we typically request a 30–45 day evidence window. For FedRAMP, plan on 90+ days as there are additional ATO readiness steps.

Action: Sarah, can you indicate which controls in your RFP are mandatory vs. nice-to-have? That will let us prioritize the 11/30 deliverables.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: control-evidence-checklist.xlsx (mapping & templates)
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@oakridgehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Certification gating and evidence timeline for Oakridge contract

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement reviewed the draft gating table and we can commit to the Q1 2027 audit window under these conditions:
- Redwood provides KMS attestation and key rotation logs by 11/30.
- Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II and the SIG/CAIQ mapping by 12/15.
- Pen test summary available by 1/10; final report available under NDA by 1/31.

I've flagged the following items as mandatory in the RFP (excerpted):
- Data flow diagrams that show PHI handling (if any).
- Control-owner attestations for access control and change management.
- Evidence of encryption at-rest and transit.

We're scheduling a call Wed 10/28 at 2pm PT to walk the gating table and answer clarifying Qs. Please invite security and compliance SMEs.

Cheers,
Sarah Lee
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Oakridge Health

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear priorities. Quick operational notes from security:
- KMS attestation: we can produce a short attestation and redacted rotation logs by 11/30. I'll attach an example KMS attestation stub to the shared Drive folder (kms-attestation-stub.txt).
- Pen test: our external vendor has a mid-December window for red-team testing; we can share a summary earlier and final report under NDA. If Oakridge needs the full report in-hand by 1/31, we should confirm the NDA path now.

I'll create the mutual action plan in the shared Drive and link it in the calendar invite. Michael/Marissa/Aditya, I'll need a quick cross-check on the control mapping sheet before we publish the 12/15 packet.

Mina Haddad
